alpha.name: Alpha
alpha.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Monad - Monas and Stoicheion - stoicheion
In the process of unfolding reality, the Alpha (Α, α) acts as the absolute principle and the Monad - Monas (unit, indivisible whole), from which all numbers and forms flow. stoicheion (first element or letter) is the transcendent potential and source of any manifestation preceding the division into subject and object. In the structure of the cosmic "body of truth" - Aletheia (Aletheia - truth), it takes the place of the head - kephale (kephale - head), being the governing principle of the whole organism. It is the “light of the mind” that spiritualizes matter and sets the rhythm for all subsequent creation.

Magical attunement and Stoicheion (stoicheion)
Root syllable: Α (Alpha) is an elementary force particle containing the potency of the entire alphabet system.
Incantation: "AKRAMMAKHAMARI" (Akrammachamari) is the great name of the power, which in magical papyri is considered the sound body of Alpha, opening access to the energies of the primordial and higher defense.
- Associative color: Golden red - foynikeos (phoinikeos - purple or fiery red), the color of the mythical Phoenix. It is believed that this color “enlightens the mind” when contemplating the letter.
Deity: Apollo (Apollon) His name was understood as the negation of plurality (ἀ-pollon), which directly connects him with the pure unity of Alpha and Monad.

Upright position: Light of the Monad
In the upright position, Alpha means returning to the source and gaining wholeness. It is a symbol of the "enlightening" mind, when consciousness becomes like pure light - phos Nu (phos noy - light of mind).
Clean creative impulse and successful start of any business.
Unity with the divine Logos - Logos (word or reason as an organizing principle).
Self-sufficiency and completeness of internal resources.

Reversed position: Hysterema - HYsterema
A reversed Alpha indicates a state of Hysterema - HYsterema (deficiency or lack), when the connection with the divine source is lost, and consciousness "falls" into the chaos of matter.
Dispersion and fragmentation of attention.
Obstacles in undertakings due to lack of a solid foundation.
The risk of “blinding” external forms that hide emptiness.

Body Practice and Meditation
- Meditation: Focus on silence before taking your first breath. Visualize a golden red Alpha in the center of your head. Imagine the sound “A” emanating from the void, creating space for your reality.
- Magical posture: Stand up straight, feet shoulder-width apart, arms stretched down and slightly to the side, forming together with the body the outline of the capital letter Alpha (triangle). Say the "A" sound loudly, pointing it from the top upwards. This pose fixes the energy of the primary element in the body and harmonizes you with the beginning of creation.
Work with the body: Alpha controls the head - kephale (kephale). To adjust, a soft massage of the parietal zone is recommended, accompanied by an internal silent pronunciation of the name "Akrammahamari" to activate the intellectual center.

beta.name: Beta
beta.content:
Cosmological profile: Diad - Dyas and Root - Hriza In the process of unfolding reality, Beta (Β, β) acts as a symbol of the Diad (Dyas - "diad", duality) and the second principle of the universe. It marks the first step from the unity of the Monad to the multiplicity of forms, representing the power of "separation" and "reflection." In the structure of the cosmic "body of truth" - Aletheia (Aletheia - "alethia", truth), Beta takes the place of the neck (trachelos - "trachelos", neck), connecting the controlling head with the body. As a mute consonant (aphonon - "athonon", a voiceless sound), it is considered an image of the heavenly Father (Pater - "pater") and the Truth, since it gains a voice only through connection with the vowel spirit.

Magical attunement and root (Hriza)
Root (seed sound): Β (Beta) is a numerical value of 2, a symbol of equilibrium and polar principles.
BOULOMENTOREB (Boylomentoreb) is the great magical name of the letter Beta, used in ancient spells to control the forces of will and intention.

Color gamut: Lunar silver (the radiance of Artemis), Forest green (the nature of the Diad), Deep indigo (the color of the celestial support).
Deity: Artemis (Artemis) It is connected with Beta through the principle of "help" (boetheia - "Boetia", help) and the management of the ways of nature.
Center in the body: Neck (trachelos).

Upright position: Harmony of the Dyad
Successful partnership and harmonious sharing of responsibilities.
"Help" (boetheia) from above or from loyal allies.
Obtaining royal power over your impulses (from the word basileys - basileus, king).

Reversed position: Chaos of separation
Conflicts caused by dual intentions.
A state of "second-rate" or failure in affairs (in antiquity the nickname "Beta" was given to those who were always second).
Impediment to communication (aphonon) in the face of circumstances.

Body Practice and Meditation
Meditation: Focus on the pulsations in the neck. Visualize the silver letter Beta, which serves as a bridge between your thoughts (head) and actions (body). Say the name "Boulomentoreb", feeling how it strengthens your will.

Magical posture: Stand sideways, legs together. Women: bend your right hand at the elbow, touching your neck with your fingers (creating the upper loop of the letter "B"), and bend your left hand the same way, resting your palm in the waist (creating a lower loop). The body serves as a vertical support of the letter. Say the "B" sound loudly, directing the vibration down your throat. For a man, the reverse pose is the left hand on the neck, the right rests on the belt.

Bodywork: Beta controls the neck. The practice of immersing attention in the process of eating, in the processes of singing and talking, as well as soft tilts and turns of the head to remove blocks in the center of “heavenly communication” is recommended.

gamma.name: Gamma
gamma.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Gaia - Gaia and Triad - Trias
Gamma (Γ, γ) acts as the principle of "fixation" and "resistance". It symbolizes Gaia (Gaia - earth) - a dense base that holds the sliding of divine meaning, turning pure Pneuma (pneyma - spirit, breath) into a shaped substance. In ancient linguistic cosmogony, Gamma belongs to the category of "silent" or "voiced" letters (aphona - athos), which in the Gnostic system represent images of the Father and Truth, since they are inexpressible without the help of vowels. Cosmologically, it marks the moment when reality takes on "friction" and "weight." According to Plato (dialogue "Kratil"), the sound of Gamma prevents "slip", expressing the idea of stickiness and fixation (glischron - glishchron). In the structure of the Body of Truth, Gamma takes the place of shoulders and hands (omoi kai cheires), responsible for the power of holding and manipulating the elements of the world.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Γ (Gamma) is an indivisible element of density and stability.
Incantation: "GENIOMOUTIG" (Geniomoythig) is a magical name for the power of ancient papyri, resonating with the energy of Gamma and opening access to the chthonic forces of base and defense.
- Colors: Terracotta (the color of the burned earth), Silver (the radiance of the moon), Deep Olive (the color of the threads of fate).
Deity: Hecate (HEkate) or Gaia (Gaia). More often, Gamma is associated with Hekata as the goddess of the intersections of the three roads (triplicities) and the mistress of the earthly and heavenly ways.
Center in the body: shoulders and hands (omoi kai cheires).

Upright position: Sustainability of the Triad
In the upright position Gamma means the materialization of plans and the acquisition of solid ground under the feet. It is a symbol of completeness (beginning-mid-end) and stability.
Successful translation of ideas into physical form.
Help from earthly forces or "motherly" protection of nature.
Gaining control of the situation through “strength” and decisive action.

Reversed position: Inertness and stagnation
The reversed Gamma indicates the excessive weight of matter, which “presses” the spirit, depriving it of mobility.
Inertness, laziness, inability to move from a dead point.
Fossilization of feelings or fixation on material losses.
Obstacles caused by the "viscosity" of circumstances or the interference of hostile chthonic forces.

Practice and magical posture
- Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together, toes turned outward. Raise your right hand to the side strictly horizontally at shoulder level, and leave your left hand firmly pressed against your body (or vice versa, depending on which side of the “angle” you form). Your silhouette should resemble the capital letter Gamma. Say the "G" sound loudly, concentrating on the base of the throat and shoulder girdle. This pose fixes your intention in the material layer of reality.
Bodywork: Gamma controls shoulders and hands. To adjust, vigorous rubbing of the shoulders (omoi) is recommended, accompanied by the invocation of "GENIOMUTIG" to empower your hands with the power of embodiment of the will.

delta.name: Delta
delta.tagline: Metaphysics of the Celestial Order and the Four-Pillar Foundation
delta.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Tetride - Tetras and Door - Thyra
In the process of unfolding reality, the Delta (Δ, δ) acts as the principle of the Tetrida (Tetras - "tetras", four) - the first stable form of the manifested world. It symbolizes the four celestial elements (stoicheia - "stoheia", elements or elements): earth, air, fire and water, which hold the structure of the universe. If Alpha is the point and Gamma is the angle, then the Delta is the first surface, the triangle fixing spirit in matter. Cosmologically, it is the root of the Decade (Deka - "deca", ten), since the sum of the first four numbers (1+2+3+4) gives the sacred number ten. In ancient atomism, it is understood as the Door (Thyra - "tour", door), through which the divine impulse enters the physical plane. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth" Delta takes the place of the breast (Stethe - "stetete", chest), being a shield and receptacle of vital breath.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
- Root (seed sound): Δ (Delta) - the sound of fixation and rest of the tongue, creating a "stasis" (stasis - "stasis", standing or immobility).
Incantation: "DEMOGENED" (Demogenede) is a magical name for power from ancient papyri used to order chaos and invoke heavenly justice.
Associative color: Deep Indigo (depth of water), Emerald Green (life of the elements), Burned Bronze (gate fortress).
Deity: Hermes (HErmes) He is the Lord of the Ways and the Doors, the vehicle between the worlds, connecting the four sides of the world.
Center in the body: Breast (Stethe - "stetete").

Upright position: Sustainability of the Quaternary
In the upright position, Delta means the acquisition of a solid foundation and the materialization of heavenly law.
Creating a strong structure in business and personal life.
Harmony between the four elements within the practice.
Opening doors to new opportunities and hidden knowledge.
Protection and protection of the highest order.

Reversed position: Hysterema - HYsterema
A reversed Delta indicates a state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack), when the structure collapses under the weight of matter.
Destroying plans due to lack of a solid foundation.
- Locked door - impossibility of progress and stagnation in business.
An imbalance of the elements leading to physical or mental exhaustion.
The oppression of circumstances and the restriction of freedom ("prison" of matter).

Practice and magical posture
- Meditation: Focus on the center of the chest (Stethe). Visualize a shining bronze triangle that expands into a protective pyramid around you. Pronounce the "D" sound, feeling it seal your will to reality.
- Magical posture: Stand up straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Raise your hands up and join your palms above your head, forming a clear triangle silhouette with your body and legs (capital Δ). Pay attention to the center of the chest, emitting light in all four directions of the world.
- Bodywork: Delta controls the chest. The practice of deep "square" breathing (inhalation - delay - exhalation - delay on equal scores) is recommended to adjust to the rhythm of the four elements.

epsilon.name: Epsilon
epsilon.tagline: The Metaphysics of Heavenly Justice and the Fifth Element
epsilon.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Second Heaven and Quintessence
Epsilon (Ε, ε) acts as the energy of the Second Sky. It is the second in a series of seven vowels, which the Greek sages likened the seven strings of the lyre of Apollo and the seven "wandering luminaries". If the previous letters laid the foundation of matter, then Epsilon introduces into space the principle of "Pneuma" (pneyma - "Pneuma", spirit, breath), animating the form. Cosmologically, it is related to the fifth element - Aether (aither - "Aiter", the upper layer of air), or "quintessence", which permeates all the other four elements, being their finest link. In the structure of the cosmic body of truth, it takes the place of the diaphragm (diaphragma - "diaphragm", septum), separating and simultaneously connecting the higher and lower spheres of the body.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
- Root (seed sound): Ε (Epsilon) is a short vowel, symbolizing the rapid "walking" or "movement" (iesis - "yesis") of the spirit.
Incantation: "ENKYKLIE" (Enkyukliye) is a magical name for a force meaning "Cyclical" or "Circle", emphasizing the eternal rotation of the celestial spheres.
Associative colors: Shining Gold (the sunshine of Apollo), Sky Blue (the purity of Aether), Silver White (the color of justice).
Deity: Apollo (Apollon) The letter Epsilon was inscribed on his temple at Delphi, symbolizing his power over the light of mind and the harmony of the world.
Center in the body: Diaphragm (Diaphragma).

Numerical Essence - The Energy of the Pentada (Five)
The numerical value of Epsilon is 5. The Pythagoreans saw in the five the symbol of "Justice" (dikaiosyne - "dikayoshune") and harmonious union, since this is the first number that combines even (female) and odd (male) beginnings. Through this number, Epsilon binds to a five-pointed star containing the Golden Ratio proportion. Graphically, the shape of the letter was likened to the "river of scales" (plastigx - "plistinx"), which emphasizes its role as an instrument of celestial balance.

Upright position: The Light of Justice
In the upright position, Epsilon means the acquisition of inner balance and the inflow of vitality through communication with the upper world.
- The triumph of justice and the resolution of disputes.
Harmony between the soul (vowel) and the body (consonants).
Spiritualization of everyday affairs with the energy of Ether.
Success in intellectual pursuits and art.

Reversed position: Hysterema - HYsterema
The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or deficiency), when the spiritual thread connecting a person with heaven becomes thinner.
A sense of injustice, litigation with an adverse outcome.
Difficulty breathing (physical or creative), stagnation of energy in the center of the body
Loss of purpose, "grounding" of interests devoid of the spark of Ether.

Practice and magical posture
- Meditation: Focus on the diaphragm area. Imagine with each breath a golden blue light enters this center, which balances your thoughts and feelings. Visualize Epsilon as a shining arch beneath which your soul passes.

- Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together. Extend the right hand horizontally to the side (the middle line of the letter), and bend the left hand so that the palm touches the crown, and the elbow is directed to the side (the upper vault). Keep your legs tight, symbolizing the support (lower vault). This “Heavenly Libra” pose sets the body up to receive the vibrations of the Aether.

- Bodywork: Epsilon controls the diaphragm. The practice of "laughing breath" (sharp exhalations of the stomach) is recommended, since the ancients associated laughter (gelos - "gelos") with the glow of the Apollo Sun.

zeta.name: Zeta
zeta.tagline: The Metaphysics of Life Concussion and Sevenfold Completeness
zeta.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Zoe - Zoe and Concussion Energy
In the process of unfolding reality, Zeta (Ζ, ζ) acts as the principle of animation and active pulsation. It symbolizes Zoe (Zoe - "zoe", life) - the divine spark that causes matter to vibrate and "boil". If the previous letters created the structure and brought in the breath, then Zeta is the moment of transition to organic existence. According to Plato, the sound of this letter imitates the state of "boiling" (zeon - "zeon") or "concussion" (seiesthai - "seyestay"), which indicates the active, mobile nature of the spirit. In ancient atomism, Zeta is considered a "double" letter (a combination of Delta and Sigma), which cosmologically means the union of a stable base and fluid force. In the structure of the body of truth, it takes the place of the back (Noton - "noton"), being the backbone and support of the life force on which the energy of awareness rises.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Ζ (Zeta) is a vibrating sound that causes resonance throughout the body.

Incantation: "ZENOBIOThIZ" (Zenobioticis) is the magical name of the force, resonating with the septenary nature of the letter and opening access to the energies of vitality and protection of life. Also often used is the exclamation "ZEThI" (Zeti) - "Live!", which in ancient times was applied to the sundial.

Associative colors: Shining Indigo (wisdom), Emerald Green (life growth), Dazzling white (boiling energy).

Deity: Athena (Athena) She is associated with this letter as the bearer of “divine understanding” (Theonoe) and the protector of the order of life. The letter also corresponds to the Gnostic Zoe (Life) as a generative force.

Center in the body: back (Noton - "notone"), spine.

Numerical Essence - Energy of Hebdomad (Seven)
The numerical value of Zeta is 7. It is the sacred Hebdomad (HEbdomas - "gebdomas", seven), a symbol of joy, love and fullness of possibilities. The seven combines the triad of spirit and the tetrad of matter, becoming the number of the “completed cycle”. Through this number, Zeta communicates with the seven planets and seven lyre strings that harmonize the cosmos. In magical calculations, seven is considered a number "virgin", not giving birth to and not born within the decade, which gives the letter the status of higher purity and autonomy.

Upright position: The Flow of Life
In the upright position, Zeta means vigorous activity, a surge of strength and the successful overcoming of inertia.
Awakening hidden talents and creative upliftment.
Health promotion and physical endurance.
Protection from destructive influences through the enhancement of personal "shining".
Finding meaning in life and clarity of path.

Reversed position: Hysterema - HYsterema
The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", defect), when the life force is stagnated or wasted.
- Loss of tone, apathy, petrification of will.
- Spine problems or back clamps.
A sense of meaninglessness of existence, a break in the connection with the internal source of "boiling".
Chaotic, destructive vibrations in business.

Body Practice and Meditation
- Meditation: Focus on the base of the spine. Visualize how the emerald white spark begins to vibrate and slowly rise up the back, turning into a shining serpent of light. Pronounce the sound "DZ-Z-Z", feeling how each vertebra resonates.

- Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together. Bend the right hand at the elbow so that the palm lies on the crown (forming the upper corner of 'Z'), and the left hand back and down (forming the lower corner). Slightly tilt the torso to the right, creating a clear zigzag with the body. Loudly pronounce the spell "ZENOBIOThIZ", directing the will through the dorsal center.

- Bodywork: Zeta controls the back. Soft gymnastics for the spine and massage the area between the shoulder blades are recommended to release Zoe's blocked energy.

eta.name: Eta
eta.tagline: Metaphysics of Cubic Fullness and Maternal Womb
eta.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Ogdoada - Ogdoas and First cubic number
In the process of unfolding reality, Eta (Η, η) represents the energy of the Third Heaven and the principle of Ogdoada - Ogdoas ("ogdoas", eight). If the previous stages laid the dynamics, then this one introduces into space the measurement of a three-dimensional volume. The Pythagoreans and Neoplatonists saw this letter as the cube symbol (2x2x2), making it the numerical foundation of the manifested physical form. In Mark's Gnostic system, it refers to the Aeon of Ecclesia, Ekklesia ("ecclesia," congregation, or spiritual community), representing completeness and unity. In the structure of the cosmic "body of truth" it takes the place of the abdomen - Koilia (Koilia - "coilia", womb or cavity), being the center of assimilation and transformation of vital forces.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
- Root (seed sound): Η (This) - a long vowel, symbolizing "length" and "size" - Makos (mekos - "mecos", length or scale).

Incantation: "ESKOThORE" (Escotore) is a magical name for power from ancient lists, opening up access to the energies of maternal protection and cubic stability.

Associative colors: Purple-blue (kingdom), Peacock green (the color of the sacred bird Hera), Copper (the density of matter).

Deity: Hera (Ἥra) The ancients interpreted her name as an anagram of the word "Aer" (Aer - "air", air), which connects her with the life-giving breath that envelops the earth. She is the Queen of Heaven, keeping order in the bosom of the universe.

Center in the body: the abdomen (Koilia), the solar plexus.

Numerical Essence - Eightfold Energy
The numerical value of Eta is 8. This is the sacred number of the cube, symbolizing the transition from a flat drawing to a material volume. In magical calculations, the eight is considered the number of the “harmonious incarnation”, where the spirit completely penetrates into matter and acquires stability.

Upright position: Mother's blessing
In the upright position, this means fertility, security and the acquisition of a solid foundation.
Completion of the foundations for a long-term project.
Material prosperity and strong physical health.
Protection of higher powers in family and community affairs.
Ability to absorb any experience and turn it into a personal power.

Reversed position: Hysterema - HYsterema
The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema - HYsterema ("Hysterema", defect or lack), when the form becomes an empty shell.
Inertness, severity, inability to develop.
Stagnation of energy in the abdomen, problems with "digesting" life situations.
- Isolation from people close in spirit, a sense of "exile".
Excessive attachment to the material, hindering the growth of the soul.

Body Practice and Meditation
- Meditation: Focus on the navel area. Visualize a shining copper cube inside the womb. Imagine how this cube absorbs all the external chaotic influences, turning them into an ordered energy of peace and confidence.

- Magical posture: Stand up straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Extend both arms forward in front of you parallel to the floor at abdomen level, palms up, as if holding an invisible tray or bowl. Loudly pronounce the sound of "E-e" (long "e"), directing the vibration down to the center of the abdomen. This Gift Offering pose sets the body up to receive heavenly well-being.


- Bodywork: This one controls the belly. It is recommended to practice deep breathing with the “belly”, in which the inhalation of the womb expands as much as possible, symbolizing the fullness of Ogdoada.

theta.name: Theta
theta.tagline: The Metaphysics of the Celestial Ether and the Ninefold Completion
theta.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Ennead - Enneas and Aether - Aither
In the process of unfolding reality, the Theta (Θ, θ) acts as the ninth element, completing the series of units and symbolizing the sacred Ennead (Enneas - enneas, nine) - the fullness of divine forces. It correlates with the fifth element - Aether (Aither - "Aiter", the purest upper layer of air), which the Pythagoreans associated with a duodecahedron (dodecahedron). In the Gnostic system, Theta is one of the "mute" letters (aphona - "athos", voiceless), which are considered images of the heavenly Father and Truth, since they cannot be pronounced without the help of vowels. According to Plato, the shape of the letter is likened to Cosmos (Kosmos - "cosmos", order), representing a circle of the world permeated by spirit. In the structure of the Body of Truth, Theta takes the place of the hips (meroi - "measure"), being a powerful foundation that ensures the movement and stability of the whole organism.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
- Root (seed sound): Θ (Theta) is an aspirational sound, symbolizing the release of inner strength and the "breath of death" (Tanatos - thanatos), turning into a new life.

Incantation: "ThOThOYThOTh" (Totoutot) is a great name of power, representing a threefold appeal to the god Thoth (Hermes), the lord of wisdom, magic and sacred letters.

Associative colors: Electric blue (the radiance of Aether), Deep black (the mystery of the limit), Shimmering gold (the divine law).

Deity: Zeus (Zeys) as the Lord of the heavenly order and of the Aether. The letter is also closely related to Thoth (Thoth), the guardian of magical knowledge.

Center in the body: hips (Meroi).

Upright position: Space Order
In the upright position, Theta means entering the rhythm of the universe and being protected by higher forces. It is a symbol of “completeness” and finding one’s place in the divine hierarchy.
Successful completion of the cycle and transition to a new level.
Finding wisdom through understanding the structure of the world.
Protection from chaos and harmonization of relations with the law.
Access to the subtle energies of the Aether for the realization of the will.

Reversed position: Shadow of the limit
The reversed letter indicates the proximity of Thanatos (Thanatos - "thanatos", death) in the sense of the breakdown of structure and the breakdown of bonds.
- Threat of disrupting plans due to disorder.
Selfishness leading to isolation from the divine whole.
Fear of change and "fossilization" in old forms.
Conflicts with power or judicial difficulties.

Body Practice and Meditation

- Meditation: Sit in the lotus or half-lotus position. Visualize a shining sphere in the thigh area with a point in the center. Imagine how this sphere expands, turning into a transparent duodecahedron (dodecahedron) covering your entire body. Pronounce the sound "Th" as in the word "think", feeling how the Aether fills each cell.

- Magical posture: Stand up straight, the legs are wide apart (shoulder wide). Raise your hands above your head and bend them at your elbows so that your fingers touch, forming a large circle above your head and torso (the outline of the letter Θ). Tighten the muscles of the hips, concentrating a golden-blue glow in them. Say the spell "ThOThOYThOTh" loudly.

- Bodywork: Theta controls the hips. Exercises to stretch and strengthen the muscles of the pelvic girdle are recommended to activate the “support force” and prepare the body to receive high vibrations.

iota.name: Iota
iota.tagline: Metaphysics of piercing line and decimal completeness
iota.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Anthropos - Anthropos and Decade - Dekas In the process of unfolding the reality of the Iota (Ι, ι) acts as the simplest and at the same time fundamental element - "Stoicheion" (stoicheion - "stoyon", primary element or letter). This is the smallest stroke, which in the Pythagorean tradition symbolizes the "line" (gramme - "gram"), just as the Delta is a triangle. Gnostics, such as Monoim, saw in Iota the image of the "First Man" or "Anthropos" (Anthropos - "anthropos"), perceiving it as a single "Monad" (monas - "monas", unit), which is also the Decade (dekas - "decas", ten). Despite its graphical simplicity, Iota contains the fullness of the ten celestial Aeons, being the “entry point” of the divine impulse into the world of form. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth" - Aletheia Iota takes the place of the knees (gonata - "gonate"), responsible for the flexibility, support and ability to move the entire cosmic organism.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza

Root (seed sound): Ι (Iota) is the finest, penetrating vowel, symbolizing the spirit ("Pneuma"), passing through any obstacles.

Incantation: "IAEOYOI" (Iaewoi) is the great name of the force, in which the other five vowels are enclosed between the two letters of Iota, which symbolizes the spirit that encompasses the entirety of the universe.

Associative colors: Crystal white (the purity of the original stroke), Royal purple (the energy of the spirit), Steel grey (the inflexibility of the line).

Deity: Anthropos (Ἄnthropos) or Anax. It is the divine “Perfect Man” whose structure is reflected in the harmony of Iota as the simplest and most complete element.

Center in the body: Knees (Gonata).

Upright position: In the upright position Iota means gaining the inner core and achieving clarity in self-knowledge. It is a symbol of piercing awareness that sees the essence of things beyond their outer complexity.
Direct and honest follow your true will.
Success in intellectual pursuit and achievement of the state of “assembly point”.
Completeness of resources hidden in simplicity (the principle of “less is more”).
Unshakable spiritual protection.

The reversed letter indicates the state of "Histerima" (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or deficit) when the connection with the divine vertical is lost.
Pettiness, literate and the loss of a holistic vision of the situation.
Weakness in the knees is the inability to resist the pressure of circumstances or the fear of truth.
Breaking the connection with the inner self, leading to chaos and fragmentation of consciousness.
Pride devoid of real power.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit with your back straight. Visualize a thin, hair-like thread of crystal white light running vertically through your body. Focus on the knees, imagining how they become centers of power linking earth and sky. Make a long "E-I-I-I" sound, feeling it piercing your being.

Magical posture: Stand perfectly straight, the feet tightly pressed against each other. Extend your arms along your torso, pressing your palms against your thighs. The whole body should be transformed into a single vertical line (the image of the capital letter Ι). Tighten the muscles of the knees, concentrating the purple glow in them. Say the spell "IAEOYOI" loudly.

Bodywork: Iota controls the knees. It is recommended to practice conscious walking and exercises to strengthen the knee joints to ensure the body stability of Anthropos.

kappa.name: Kappa
kappa.tagline: The Metaphysics of Time and Heavenly Dominion
kappa.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Kronos - Kronos and fixation of ten In the process of unfolding reality Kappa (Κ, κ) acts as the principle of fixation and transition to the category of tens (its numerical value is 20). It symbolizes Kronos (Kronos - "cronus", time) - a deity who limits the infinite expansion of the spirit, creating a "measure" and "boundary" for the existence of the world. If Iota was a piercing line, then Kappa is a rigid support, a “knee” of time that allows reality to bend and take shape. In the Gnostic system, it is one of the “silent” letters (aphona – “athos”, voiceless), representing the images of the Father and Truth, since they are the skeleton holding the flesh of speech. In the structure of the mystical body of truth, Kappa takes the place of the shins (knemai - "knemai"), providing dynamic stability and the ability to advance in the manifested cosmos.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza

Root (seed sound): Κ (Kappa) - a brief sound of instantaneous stop, "explosion" fixation.

Incantation: "KORKOOYNOOK" (Korkoownook) is the great name of the force, which in ancient magical texts serves as the sound body of the Kappa letter, opening access to the energies of control over circumstances.

Associative colors: lead-gray (color of Kronos), deep blue (power), steel (fortress support).

Deity: Kronos (Kronos) As the lord of time and the golden age, he endows the letter with the power of kairos (kairos - auspicious moment). Kappa is also inextricably linked to the concept of "Kyrios" (Kyrios) - Lord or Lord.

Center in the body: tibia (Knemai).

Upright position: Power over the moment In the upright position, Kappa means gaining internal control and discipline. It is a symbol of entering the legal rhythm of life.
Timely action, success in meeting deadlines.
Strengthening authority and gaining real power over the situation.
Protection through clear boundaries and rules.
The manifestation of the qualities of "Kyrios" - the master of his fate.

The reversed letter indicates a state of "Hysterema" (Hysterema - "Hysterema", defect), manifesting as a conflict with time.
Linked legs: Inability to take a step due to external limitations or fear.
Despotism, harsh pressure from the leadership or the state.
Missed opportunities due to slowness or discipline.
Chaos in affairs caused by a lack of structure and order.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit on a chair, feet tightly pressed to the floor. Focus on the shins, imagining how they are poured with steel power. Visualize a gray Kappa letter that cuts off all “untimely” thoughts and attachments. Pronounce a brief, clear "K!" sound, feeling it seal your will to reality.

Magical posture: Stand up straight. Put your right leg aside and bend it in your knee. Raise your right hand up and to the right at an angle of 45 degrees, and lower your left hand down and to the right at the same angle. Your silhouette should resemble the capital letter Κ. Say the spell "KORKOOYNOOK" loudly and imperiously.

Bodywork: Kappa controls the shins. Massage of calf muscles and the practice of conscious "grounding" are recommended to develop resistance in the face of changing time.

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.tagline: Metaphysics of Sliding Harmony and the Golden Ratio
lambda.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Logos - Logos and Golden Ratio In the process of unfolding Lambda reality (Λ, λ) acts as the principle of mathematical progression and harmonic division. It symbolizes the "Logos" (Logos - here in the sense of proportion or relation), which sets the rhythm of the life of the universe. In the Timaeus dialogue, Plato describes a Lambda-shaped diagram that unites rows of numbers through the principles of "double" and "three", creating the basis for the world soul. Cosmologically, Lambda is the “acute angle,” the moment when the pure energy of the spirit begins to “slip” smoothly into matter without encountering resistance. In the structure of the mystical body of truth, it takes the place of the ankles (sphyra - "Sfira"), providing flexibility and turning power of the entire structure of the cosmic organism.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza

Root (seed sound): Λ (Lambda) is a fluid, semi-vocal sound that expresses the idea of sweetness (glyky, sweet) and malleability.

Incantation: "LOYLOENEL" (Louloenel) is a magical power name from ancient lists that serves as the sonic body of the letter, allowing the practice to tune in to the vibrations of luck and the smooth flow of events.

Associative colors: Pearl white (color of meekness), Sea blue (depth and fluidity), Shimmering silver (shine of the ankles).

Deity: Summer (Leto) She personifies "Leyon" (leion - gentle, smooth) - the soft nature of divinity, preceding the birth of light (Apollo). Lambda is also related to the element of water.

Center in the body: Ankles (Sphyra).

Upright position: In the upright position, Lambda means entering a state of “flow,” where every action is done on time and effortlessly. It is a symbol of successful transition and harmonious development.
Smooth progress in business, no conflict.
Finding the “golden mean” and the right proportion in life.
Flexibility of mind, the ability to adapt to any change.
Attracting the right people and resources through personal charm

Inverted letter indicates the state of "Histerima" (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack), manifesting as "stuck" and spiritual clumsiness.
Loss of support, "twisted ankles" in cases and decisions.
Excessive rigidity where you need flexibility leading to fracture.
Violation of harmony, ugliness of proportions in plans or relationships.
A state of scarcity of resources due to an inability to “slip” along with circumstances.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit comfortably, close your eyes. Visualize the glowing silver letter Lambda in the ankle area. Imagine your body becoming fluid and malleable like seawater. Pronounce a long "L-L-L" sound, feeling it remove all the clamps in your mind.

Magical posture: Stand up straight with your legs wide (shoulders wide) so that your feet form an inverted letter "V" (the outline of the capital Λ). Connect your hands at chest level in a prayer gesture. Pay attention to your ankles, feeling them as hinges connecting you to the rhythm of the earth. Say "LOYLOENEL" loudly and singly.

Bodywork: Lambda controls the ankles. It is recommended to gently rotate the feet and massage the ankle area using incense oils to activate the "force of maneuver" in life.

mu.name: Mu
mu.tagline: Metaphysics of the Great Multitude and Mother Waters
mu.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Meme - Mem and Middlena - Mesotes In the process of unfolding reality Mü (Μ, μ) acts as the principle of transition to the completeness of material embodiment and control of the set. Graphically, it goes back to the Egyptian hieroglyph for water (zigzag line), which connects it with the primordial ocean of potencies and the Gnostic concept of “mem”. In ancient linguistics, Mu is considered a "semi-voiced" letter (Hemiphonon - "hemiphoneon", letters. "semi-voiced"), which has the ability to sound long. Cosmologically, it represents the "Sredina" (Mesotes - "mesotes", mediation or middle), connecting the beginning and the end in the formula "arche, mesotes kai teleute". The Gnostics saw in Mü the image of "multipleness" (Myrioi - "myrioi", ten thousand or innumerable set), pointing to the infinite forms of life born from the mother waters of the cosmos. In the structure of the mystical body of truth, it occupies the place of the feet (Podes - "podes", feet), being the foundation on which the entire manifested world rests.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza

Root (seed sound): Μ (Mu) is a bowed lip sound, symbolizing the retention, nourishment and "buzzing" of primordial matter.

Incantation: "MOROThOEPNAM" (Morotoepnam) is the magical name of a force from ancient lists, resonating with fertility energies, protecting life and directing the flows of incarnate forces.

Associative colors: Deep sea blue (abyss), Penisto-silver (surface of water), Emerald (vital moisture).

Deity: Thetis (Thetis) or sea nymphs as the personification of generative waters. In the mantic table, Mu also refers to the mystical image of "Mary" (Maria) as "Sea" and mistress "South".

Center in the body: feet (Podes).

The fullness of the incarnation in the upright position of Mu means the achievement of material stability and the successful realization of the accumulated potential. It is a symbol of fertility and “fullness” of resources.
Successful completion of long-term processes and tangible results.
A deep intuition based on a connection with the original rhythms of nature ("world waters").
Finding a strong foothold in life and support from family or community
The ability to manage chaos and large amounts of resources.

The reversed letter indicates the condition of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack), manifesting as "flooding" or loss of soil under the feet.
Feeling helpless in the face of surging circumstances ("drowning" in business).
Emotional instability caused by an excess of uncontrollable feelings.
Loss of individuality in the mass, exposure to foreign influence.
Difficulties with the foundation of affairs or physical heaviness in the legs, hindering progress.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front of you. Focus on the soles of the feet. Visualize how cool blue light rises from the ground through the feet, filling the entire body. Pronounce a long humming sound of "M-mm" with tightly compressed lips, feeling how the vibration calms the mind and strengthens the body.

Magical posture: Stand up straight with your legs wide open. Lean forward and touch the floor between your feet with your fingertips so that your arms, legs and back form the outline of a capital M (two vertices and a deflection). In this position, take a deep breath and exhale the name "MOROThOEPNAM", directing the will to the feet.

Bodywork: Mu controls the feet. It is recommended to practice conscious contact of the feet with the ground (“grounding”) and massage the soles to release stagnant energy and gain confidence.

nu.name: Nu
nu.tagline: Metaphysics of internal echo and hidden support
nu.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Inner - endon and Hidden - entos In the process of unfolding reality Nu (Ν, ν) acts as the principle of "internal resonance". According to Plato (dialogue "Kratil"), the sound of this letter expresses "inner" (endon - "endon") and "inner" (entos - "entos"), creating an echo of a voice within itself. In the ancient linguistic system, Nu is classified as a "semi-consonant" letter (Hemiphonon - "hemiphonon"), which has the ability of long-lasting, penetrating sound. In the structure of the cosmic "body of truth" Nu, along with the letter Mu, occupies the place of feet (Podes - Podes), being the end point of support and the foundation through which spirit contacts dense matter. It is the “internal echo” that allows awareness to penetrate the very essence of things without lingering on their surface.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Ν (Nu) is a sound resonating in the depth of the nasopharynx, the numerical root of which is 5 (from the value of 50).

Incantation: "NERXIARXIN" (Nerxiarxin) is a great name of power from ancient magical lists, serving as the sound body of the letter Nu and opening access to the energies of secret knowledge and night protection.

Associative colors: Midnight black (the color of primordial darkness), sea turquoise (depth and permeability), steel gray (the fortress of the foundation).

Nix (Nyx - "Nix", Night) - the primordial goddess, whose name is consonant with the letter and whose nature conceals all forms of future manifestation.

Center in the body: feet (Podes).

In the upright position, Nu means gaining stability through appeal to the inner source of power. It is a symbol of “hidden” treasure and stability.
Successful completion of business with a solid foundation.
Discover hidden truths and intuitive understanding of the situation.
Magical defense based on invisible, "internal" factors.
The ability to stand firm and stay true to principles.

The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or deficiency), manifesting as "loss of soil".
Instability, fluctuations and loss of life reference points.
Revealing secrets that should have remained hidden, leading to chaos.
"Weakness in the feet" is the inability to finish.
False beliefs devoid of inner truth.

Body Practice and Meditation
Meditation: Sit straight, your feet tightly pressed against the floor. Visualize how from your feet deep into the earth go turquoise threads that connect you with the core of the world. Pronounce a long humming "N-n-n" sound, directing the vibration from the head down to the soles of the feet. Feel how the “internal echo” clears your mind of external noise.

Magical posture: Stand up straight. Take a step forward with your right foot, bent it slightly in the knee. Raise the left hand vertically up, and direct the right hand diagonally down to the toe of the left leg. Your body should form a zigzag silhouette resembling the capital letter Ν. Tighten the muscles of the feet and imperiously pronounce the spell "NERXIARXIN".

Bodywork: Nu controls the feet. The practice of mindful grounding and massage of the points on the soles is recommended to activate the “secret energy” and strengthen the connection with reality.

xi.name: Xi
xi.tagline: Metaphysics of support and celestial equilibrium
xi.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Xenos - Xenos and Cosmic order In the process of unfolding reality Xi (Ξ, ξ) acts as a complex, "double" element (diployn - "diplun"), combining the hardness of Kappa and fluidity of Sigma. It symbolizes the principle of Xenos (Xenos - "xenos", alien or guest), indicating the presence of the divine spirit as a "guest" in the material world. In numerical order, Xi corresponds to the number 60, which in ancient tradition was associated with the cycles of time and celestial measures. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth" - Aletheia (Aletheia - "alethia", truth) Xi, along with the letter Lambda, takes the place of the ankles (Sphyra - "Sfira"), serving as a hinge and equilibrium point that allows the entire cosmic organism to remain stable when moving. Cosmologically, it is a bridge between the celestial spheres and the earth’s base.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Ξ (Xi) is a complex, "dry" sound that vibrates like a strained string.

Incantation: "KSONOFOINAKS" (Xonophoenax) is a great power name from magical papyri, resonating with the energies of celestial justice and opening access to the defenses of Zenith.

Associative colors: Celestial azure (the sphere of Zeus), Saturated blue (the depth of space), Sparkling bronze (the fortress of joints).

Deity: Zeus (Zeys) On the island of Fera, the letter Xi was used as a symbol of the Thunderer himself, personifying his power over the world order. It also corresponds to the balance of forces.

Center in the body: Ankles (Sphyra).

In the upright position Xi means finding the perfect balance and successful maneuvering in difficult circumstances. It is a symbol of “just measure” and support from above.
Finding a foothold in an unstable situation.
Successful negotiations and mutually beneficial agreements.
Spiritual protection and protection of the supreme law.
Explain the hidden links between events.

The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or deficit), manifesting as a "twisted ankle" or the collapse of plans.
Loss of balance, chaos in affairs and thoughts.
Injustice caused by the violation of the cosmic scales.
Fragile relationships, broken ties due to lack of flexibility.
Disorientation and loss of life path.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit straight with your feet parallel to each other. Visualize how your ankles envelop the azure glow, turning into durable bronze hoops. Pronounce the sharp sound of "x-s-s", imagining how he builds up the vertical axis of your will, connecting it with the zenith of the sky.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, legs tight together. Extend both arms horizontally to the sides on three levels (in turn): overhead, at chest level and at hip level, fixing each position with a sharp exhalation. In the final stage, bend your arms at your elbows at right angles upwards, forming a complex balance structure with your head and torso. Loudly and imperiously pronounce the spell "KSONOPHOINACS".

Bodywork: Xi controls his ankles. It is recommended to warm up the ankle joints and consciously distribute body weight to develop a "sense of weight" and the ability to resist any pressure.

omicron.name: Omicron
omicron.tagline: Metaphysics of the Completed Cycle and the Celestial Circle
omicron.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Kyuklos - kyklos and Fifth Sky In the process of unfolding reality Omicron (Ο, ο) acts as a symbol of the perfect Circle - kyklos ("kuklos", circle) and the Fifth Sky. In the series of seven sacred vowels - phoneen (phoneen - "vowel", letters. "having a voice"), which the Pythagoreans likened to the strings of the cosmic lyre, Omicron takes the place of the sphere of Mars. This letter embodies the principle of limitation and at the same time completeness, fixing spiritual energy in the ideal form of a disk. If Iota was a line, then Omicron is a volumetric integrity, an orbit along which the stars move. In the structure of the mystical "Body of Truth" - Aletheia (Aletheeia - "truth") Omicron, together with the letter Kappa, takes the place of the legs - knemai (knemai - "knemai", shins or legs), providing rhythmic promotion and support for the entire heavenly vault.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Ο (Omicron) is a short vowel that expresses the idea of "round" and "closed".

Incantation: "ORNEOPhAO" (Orneofao) is the magical name of a force from ancient lists, which is considered the sound emanation of a letter that controls the rhythms of fate and the defense of borders.

Associative colors: Bloody red (energy of Mars), Obsidian (mystery of the limit), Shining gold (solar disk).

Deity: Ares (Ares - Mars), lord of the fifth gate of the cosmos, giving strength to overcome obstacles and maintain order.

Center in the body: Legs (Knemai).

In the upright position, Omicron means entering the natural rhythm of the universe and protection through the acquisition of integrity. It is a symbol of the “perfect circle” of actions.
Successful completion of the started cycle and transition to a new round of development.
Finding internal stability and armor against external chaos.
Harmonious movement towards the goal, when the circumstances themselves line up in the right order.
Magical defense based on the inviolability of personal boundaries.

Reversed position: The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema - HYsterema ("Hysterema", deficiency or deficit), manifesting as a rhythm disturbance or stagnation.
Loss of direction, movement in a false circle.
"Weakness in the legs" - lack of a firm position or fear of the coming changes.
Violation of harmony in affairs caused by non-compliance with cosmic deadlines.
Vulnerability to external pressure due to "cracks" in defense.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit straight, your feet tightly pressed against the floor. Visualize a bright red glowing circle in the leg area, which gradually expands into a protective sphere around the whole body. Pronounce a brief, clear "O!" sound, feeling it pulsating in each cell, synchronizing you with the pulse of the earth.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together. Lean forward and touch the tips of the fingers of the toes, forming a closed contour with your body (the outline of the letter Ο). In this position, take a deep breath and exhale the name "ORNEOPhAO", directing energy from the feet up the body.

Bodywork: Omicron controls the legs. It is recommended to walk consciously (each step is a statement of will) and massage the legs to remove clamps that interfere with free movement through life.

pi.name: Pi
pi.tagline: The Metaphysics of the Fire Father and the Support of the Knees
pi.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Pater - Pater and Fire Tetrad In the process of unfolding reality Pi (Π, π) acts as the embodiment of the Pater principle (Pater - "father", father) - the original male creative force that brings into the cosmos the heat of life. In ancient atomism, it belongs to the category of “silent” letters (aphona – “athos”, voiceless), which in the Gnostic system of Mark are considered images of the heavenly Father, since they precede sound and are its support. Cosmologically, Pi relates to the element of Fire - Pure (pyr) and Platonic body - tetrahedron (quatrahedron), symbolizing active, penetrating and transforming energy. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth" - Aletheia (Aletheia - truth) Pi takes the place of the knees (gonata - "gonate"), responsible for the ability of a person to bow to the higher and at the same time for a powerful dynamic support of the whole organism.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza

Root (seed sound): Π (Pi) is an explosive lip sound, symbolizing the release of energy and the beginning of action.

Incantation: "PYROBARYP" (Pyrobaryp) - the great name of the force, which in magical papyri is considered the sound body of the letter Pi. It clearly hears the Greek root "pure" (pyr - fire), which emphasizes the fiery nature of this sign.

Associative colors: Flame-red (the anger and passion of Ares), Sun-gold (the authority of the Father), Coal-black (the power of the foundation).

Deity: Ares (Ares) as lord of the fiery tetrahedron and god of impulsive power. The letter is also inextricably linked to the image of the Father (Pater), the supreme hierarch of the universe.

Center in the body: Knees (Gonata).

In the upright position, Pi means the acquisition of spiritual authority, protection from the higher male forces and the successful implementation of the willful impulse.
Manifest leadership qualities and firmness in decisions.
Protect the Fire of the Law from any chaotic influences.
Success in cases that require determination, speed and discipline.
Finding support (strong knees) in life trials.

The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or deficit), when the creative fire turns into a destructive fire or goes out.
Uncontrollable aggression leading to self-destruction.
"Weakness in the knees" - loss of faith, fear of responsibility and escape from reality.
Conflicts with power or suppression by a despotic figure.
Disruption of plans due to lack of inner core and discipline.

Body Practice and Meditation
Meditation: Sit on your knees (student posture). Visualize how two bright red pyramids (tetrahedra) begin to pulsate in the knee area. With each breath, imagine the fiery force rising from body to head, filling you with determination. Make a sharp "P!" sound, feeling the impulse in the center of the abdomen.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Raise both arms upwards and bend them at the elbows at right angles so that the forearms are parallel to the floor and point to the sides (or to each other), forming the upper bar and side supports of the capital letter Π. Tighten your knee muscles and pronounce the "PIROBARUP" spell loudly.

Bodywork: Pi controls his knees. Recommended exercises to strengthen the ligaments and massage the knee area with warming oils to activate the energy of the "Fiery Father".

rho.name: Rho
rho.tagline: Metaphysics of eternal motion and vibrating force
rho.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Kinesis - kinesis and Lifestream In the process of unfolding reality Rho (Ρ, ρ) acts as the embodiment of the principle of motion - kinesis (kinesis - "kinesis"). According to Plato, the sound of this letter was chosen by the "name-giver" as a tool for imitating every impulse, since when it is pronounced, the language vibrates and does not remain at rest. Rho represents flow (roe - Hroe), awe (tromos - tromos) and the active influence of the spirit on matter, expressed in the verbs "crush" (Trawane) or "spin" (Ryumbain). Cosmologically, it relates to the element of Air and the geometric shape of the octahedron (octahedron), representing the hot and wet nature of Pneuma (pneyma - spirit, breath). In the structure of the cosmic "body of truth" - Aletheia (Aletheia - truth), Rho, along with the letter Theta, takes the place of the hips - measure (meroi - "measure"), responsible for the dynamic power and ability of the body to advance.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Ρ (Rho) is a vibrating sound that causes resonance in the chest and throat.

Incantation: "REROYTOER" (Reroutoer) - the magical name of the force, which in ancient papyri is considered the sound body of the letter Rho, controlling the energies of transformation.

Associative colors: Bright scarlet (the color of vital blood), Saffron (the energy of Dionysus), Oxidated silver (the shine of vibration).

Dionysus (Dionysos) is the god of ecstatic movement and vital moisture. The letter is also associated with the principle of “ruler” (Sarah), which is able to transform the mortal into the immortal through the addition of its power.

Center in the body: hips (Meroi).

In the upright position, Rho means gaining the impulse to overcome stagnation and entering the rhythm of the general movement.
Successful start of active actions and rapid progress towards the goal.
A surge of vitality and creative inspiration ("hot" breath of the spirit).
The ability to "crush" obstacles through strong-willed effort.
Harmonious combination of internal strength and external mobility.

The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack) when the movement becomes chaotic or completely stops.
Meaningless vanity, wasting energy (vibration without direction).
"Weakness in the hips" - the inability to take a decisive step or loss of support in life.
Destructive conflicts caused by uncontrollable anger or passion.
A feeling of "freezing" of affairs and loss of connection with the flow of life.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit straight. Visualize a vibrating scarlet sphere in the thigh area. Imagine how the sound "R-R-R" begins to rock this sphere, turning it into a stream of fiery air that rises up the spine. Pronounce a long "R" sound, concentrating on the physical sensation of trembling in the tongue and larynx.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, legs tightly pressed against each other. One hand (right or left) bend at the elbow and raise up so that the palm touches the back of the head or shoulder, forming a loop. The second hand should be firmly pressed against the body. Your silhouette should repeat the outline of the capital letter Ρ. Tighten your hip muscles and pronounce the spell "REROYTOER" loudly.

Bodywork: Rho controls his hips. Recommended dynamic exercises for the development of flexibility of the hip joints and conscious walking, where each step is felt as a manifestation of the will to move.

sigma.name: Sigma
sigma.tagline: The Metaphysics of Breath and Secret Salvation
sigma.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Hemiphonon - Hemiphonon and Breath - pneyma In the process of unfolding reality Sigma (Σ, σ, ς) acts as the principle of "breathing" and dynamic concussion. In ancient linguistics, it is classified as "hemiphonon" (Hemiphonon - "semi-voiced"), occupying an intermediate position between the vowel-spirit and mute consonants-matter. According to Plato, the sound of this letter was chosen to imitate "whistling", "concussion" or "excitation", which associates Sigma with active Pneuma (pneyma - "spirit" or "breath"), permeating dense forms. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth", Sigma takes the place of the Belly (Koilia - "coilia", womb or cavity), responsible for the assimilation of divine energy and the storage of life force. Cosmologically, it corresponds to the sign of Scorpio, which governs the processes of transformation and hidden power.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Σ (Sigma) is a hissing, "whistling" sound, symbolizing snake wisdom and primordial movement.

Incantation: "SOTER" (Soter) is a great power name meaning "Savior." According to the principle of notaricon (abbreviation), Sigma is the first letter of this sacred title, which gives the practitioner protection and the ability to regenerate.

Associative colors: Deep Purpur (kingdom), Smoldering coal (hidden heat), Neon green (snake energy).

Deity: Savior (Soter) The letter is also historically associated with the image of the Serpent (Serpens), which is reflected in its ancient and cursive designs.

Center in the body: ANIMINE (Koilia).

Upright position: In the upright position, Sigma means gaining salvation through the harmonization of internal processes and the accumulation of spiritual energy.
Magical defense based on the power of the breath of life.
Successful transformation of negative circumstances into personal power.
Obtaining control over instincts and passions ("fire in the stomach").
A close connection with the flow of life and an intuitive sense.

The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack), when the inner force dissipates or turns into poison.
Loss of mental balance and “disruption” of internal rhythms.
Problems with "digesting" reality, stagnation of energy in the womb.
Danger from hidden enemies or their own repressed fears.
Destructive "concussion" of life without a creative purpose.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit comfortably with your hands on the lower abdomen. Visualize a luminous spiral snake there. As you exhale, pronounce the long, penetrating “S-s-s” sound, feeling the vibration concentrating in the center of the womb, purifying it and filling it with the power of the Savior.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, legs together. Bend the body at three points, forming a sharp zigzag (head tilted forward, torso back, legs bent at the knees) so that your silhouette resembles the capital letter Σ. Hands stretched down along the body. Loudly and imperiously pronounce the spell "SOTER", focusing on the abdomen.

Bodywork: Sigma controls the belly. Recommended breathing practices "abdominal type" to activate the Koilia center and strengthen Pneuma inside the body, as well as exercise "belly wave".

tau.name: Tau
tau.tagline: The Metaphysics of the Cross and the Indestructible Seal
tau.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Stauros - Stayros and celestial support In the process of unfolding reality Tau (Τ, τ) acts as the principle of fixation and completion. Graphically and etymologically, it dates back to the ancient symbol of the cross (stayros - "stauros", the cross), which in ancient thought was understood as a tool for the stability of the world. The Pythagoreans saw in Tau the image of the "right angle" - an ideal geometric support that keeps the structure of the cosmos from decay. In Mark's Gnostic system, Tau is one of the "silent" letters (aphona - "athos", voiceless), which serve as the bone skeleton of the "body of truth", representing the unchanging will of the Father. The numerical value of Tau is 300, which in mystical numerology was associated with salvation and protection (like the length of Noah’s Ark at the elbows). In the structure of the cosmic organism, it occupies the place of the Spina (Noton - "noton"), being the ridge and vertical axis on which all manifested existence rests.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza

Root (seed sound): Τ (Tau) is a deaf explosive sound that instantly interrupts the flow of air and captures the here and now moment.

Incantation: "TAYROPOLIT" (Tauropolitan) - a magical name of the force from ancient papyri, resonating with the energy of the letter and opening access to the powers of the heavenly guard and protection.

Associative colors: Saffron (light of truth), Deep blue (energy of Sagittarius), Burned bronze (fortress of the seal).

Deity: Artemis (as Tauropolis) or the highest principle of the celestial architect. In the celestial hierarchy, Tau corresponds to the vector of aspiration.

Center in the body: SPIN (Noton - "notone"), the spinal column.

Upright position: In the upright position, Tau means the acquisition of a solid foundation, protection from above and the successful assertion of one’s will in matter.
Magical protection based on the sign of the cross or the seal of truth.
Completion of the formation of a strong "back" in business and life.
Successful overcoming of trials through perseverance and loyalty to principles.
Having an inner core and the ability to withstand any pressure.

The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack), when the support turns into a heavy burden.
The oppression of circumstances, "pressing on the shoulders" and deprivation of freedom.
Loss of the spiritual vertical, spiritual fatigue and slouching of the will.
Destroying plans for lack of solid foundation.
A feeling of “crucifixion” between conflicting desires and duty.

Body Practice and Meditation
Meditation: Sit down with a perfectly straight back. Visualize along the spine a radiant bronze axis. Imagine how, at the level of your shoulders, this axis is crossed by a horizontal bar of light, forming the Tau shape inside you. Pronounce a brief, clear “T!” sound as the vibration seals your consciousness to the center of your physical body.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together, toes turned outward. Spread your hands strictly to the sides horizontally at shoulder level, palms forward. Your entire body should be transformed into a living cross (the outline of the capital letter Τ). Tighten your back muscles, feeling them like a shield. Loudly and imperiously pronounce the spell "TAYROPOLIT", asserting your immunity in space.

Bodywork: Tau controls his back. Practices of stretching the spine and strengthening the back muscles are recommended to make the body a worthy receptacle for the spirit of Tau.

upsilon.name: Upsilon
upsilon.tagline: The Metaphysics of Moral Choice and Celestial Ascension
upsilon.content:
Cosmogonic profile: The Sixth Sky and the Crossroads of Pythagoras In the process of unfolding reality, Upsilon (Υ, υ) acts as the energy of the Sixth Sky and corresponds to the sphere of Jupiter (Zeus). This letter is one of the seven sacred vowels (phoneen - "Fonean" having a voice) that animate the "mute" body of the cosmos with the spirit. In the ancient philosophical tradition, Upsilon was called the “letter of the crossroads”. Pythagoras saw in its bifurcated form (Y) the symbol of human life and the moment of moral choice: the lower stem represents the early years when character is not yet formed, and the two branches - the paths of virtue and vice. The path to the right, narrower and steeper, leads to bliss, while the left, wide and easy, throws the traveler into chaos. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth" Upsilon takes the place of the diaphragm (Diaphragma - "diaphragm", septum), acting as a bridge between the intellectual and vital centers of the body.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Υ (Upsilon) is a sound that symbolizes the soul’s desire for two opposite principles or its immersion in the depths of knowledge.

Incantation: "YPEPhENOYRY" (Ipefenuri) is the magical name of the power from the ancient lists, serving as the sound body of the letter and opening access to the energies of celestial patronage. In magical papyri, it is also found as ARTORAN.

Associative colors: Sky blue (purity of air), Gold (glory of Zeus), Bright white (light of virtue).

Deity: Zeus (Zeys) is the Lord of the sixth realm, giving right direction and law. In the Christian tradition, the letter is associated with the image of the Son (Huios - HYios).

Center in the body: diaphragm (Diaphragma).

The numerical essence is the Energy of the Tetrad (Quartet) The numerical value of Upsilon is 400. Its numerical root (pythmen) is 4, which connects the letter with the Tetrad and the force of the four elements that hold the world. Gnostics believed that this letter indicates the essence of the soul (Psyche - "Psyche"), which is the mediator between the higher and lower mind.

Upright position: The Path of Virtue
In the upright position, Upsilon means finding a clear path and spiritual elevation. It is the symbol of the lover of wisdom (philosophos) who chooses truth.
Successfully overcoming moral dilemmas.
Protection of higher powers and gaining authority (Jupiter energy).
A breakthrough in self-knowledge and achieving a state of "celestial equilibrium."
Protection through loyalty to your purpose.

Reversed position: Hysterema - HYsterema The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", lack or deficit), when the soul is lost in the way and is carried away by illusions.
Mistake of choice leading to devastating consequences.
Indulging in vices, laziness and spiritual stagnation.
Loss of connection with the higher law, conflicts with conscience or authority.
Difficulty breathing (physical or creative) and stagnant energy in the center of the body

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit straight, put your hands on the heart area (center of Pneuma). Visualize how two branches of light rise from this center in both directions, forming a shining bowl or the letter Upsilon above your head. Pronounce a long, vibrating "Y-y-yu" sound, feeling the diaphragm widening, filling the body with celestial air (aer - "aer").

Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together. Raise both hands upwards and spread them to the sides at an angle of 45 degrees, forming your body the shape of a capital letter Υ. Take a look at the sky, focusing on the diaphragm. Loudly and solemnly pronounce the spell "YPEPhENOYRY", affirming your choice of the path of light.

Bodywork: Upsilon controls the diaphragm. The practice of deep, conscious breathing is recommended to strengthen the connection between the upper and lower worlds within a person.

phi.name: Phi
phi.tagline: Metaphysics of manifested light and spiritual breath
phi.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Phos - Phos and Breath - Pneyma In the process of unfolding reality Phi (Φ, φ) acts as the embodiment of the principle of manifest light - Phos (Phos - "phos", light). In ancient linguistics, it is classified as a "spiratory" or "thick" consonant - dasea (dasea - "dasea", rough or thick), which connects it with Pneuma (pneyma - "Pneuma", spirit or breath), permeating matter. The Gnostics saw in Phi the symbol of the “spiritual man” hidden within the flesh, and related it to the energy that animates the “dumb” elements of the cosmos. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth" - Aletheia (Aletheia - truth), Phi takes the place of the breast - stethos (stethos - "stethos", chest or heart), being the center of radiation of internal force and the receptacle of the divine voice.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza

Root (seed sound): Φ (Phi) is a voiceless aspirated sound, symbolizing a powerful ejection of the spirit from the depths of nature.

Incantation: "PhIMEMAMEPh" (Fimemememeph) is a magical power name from ancient papyri that serves as the sound body of the letter Phi. This name is used to awaken the inner light and clear space with sound.

Associative colors: Dazzling white (purity of light), Golden sun (energy of Phos), Shining purple (spiritual power).

Deity: Light (Phos) as personalized spiritual intelligence. The letter is also associated with the image of Philopael, an angel guarding the purity of thoughts.

Center in the body: Breast (Stethos).

The numerical essence is the energy of five hundred The numerical value of the letter Phi is 500. Its numerical root is 5, which brings us back to the Pentada energy, the symbol of justice and ether. At the level of hundreds, however, Phi represents a complete form of this force, manifested as an “all-pervading light” that reaches the furthest corners of creation. In ancient times, the shape of Phi was sometimes compared to a solar disk pierced by a vertical axis of spirit.

Upright position: In the upright position, Phi means the triumph of the spirit over matter and the attainment of clarity of vision. It is a symbol of a man who has become a “conductor” of heavenly light.
Enlightenment of the mind and understanding of hidden truths.
Success in matters that require eloquence and persuasiveness (the power of "voice").
Magical protection through personal aura enhancement.
Finding peace and harmony at the center of your being.

Reversed position: The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack), when the inner fire is extinguished or suffocated in the crampedness of selfishness.
Loss of inspiration and spiritual blindness.
Diseases associated with the chest or difficulty breathing.
A lie hidden behind beautiful words ("false sound").
Feeling emptiness and lack of purpose in life.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Focus on the center of your chest. Visualize there a small dot of dazzling white light. Imagine how with each breath it expands, filling the chest and going outside the body, turning into a radiant sphere. Pronounce a protracted "F-F-H" sound, feeling the breath cleansing your heart.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together. Place your palms on your hips (or blink), spreading your elbows to the sides so that your arms and torso form a circle, and your head and legs create a vertical line (the image of the letter Φ). Open the chest and direct attention to its center. Say the spell "PhIMEMAMEPh" loud and clear.

Bodywork: Phi controls the chest area. Exercises on opening the shoulder girdle and deep "heart" breathing are recommended to strengthen the connection with the energy of Phos.

chi.name: Chi
chi.tagline: Metaphysics of the Crossroads of Worlds and the Fiery Soul
chi.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Psychogony - psychogonia and World Soul
Chi (Χ, χ) acts as a symbol of the structure of the World Soul. In Timaeus, Plato describes how the demiurge created the universe by joining two bands of "substances of the soul" in the shape of the letter Chi (X), and then bent their ends into circles. This image of “crossing” symbolizes the union of two fundamental movements of the cosmos – the Identical and the Other. In ancient linguistics, Chi is classified as a "spiratory" consonant - dasea (dasea - "dasea", thick or rough). Neoplatonist Theodore Azinsky considered this sound “hot and vitalizing” precisely because of its fiery, aspirating nature. In the structure of the mystical body of truth, Chi takes the place of the Shoulders and Hands (omoi Hama chersi - "amoy ama chersi"), personifying the force that holds and directs the manifested world.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Χ (Chi) is the sound of active breathing that releases vital warmth.
Incantation: "KHENNEOFEOCH" (ChENNEOPhEOCh) is a magical power name from ancient papyri, serving as the sound body of the letter Chi.
Associative colors: Fire-red (heat of the Soul), Deep brown (earthly support of Capricorn), Golden (light of Chronos).
Deity: Chronos (Chronos - "chronos", Time). The letter Chi was often used as an abbreviation of his name. It is also associated with the image of Christ (Christos - "Christ", anointed) through the sacred monogram Hi-Ro.

Center in the body: Shoulders and hands.

Numerical Essence - The Energy of Six Hundred
The numerical value of Chi is 600. In the Hellenic divination, Chi refers to the sign of Capricorn (Aigokeros - "igoceros"), which indicates the moment of the highest ascent and transition of energy from one form to another. As a symbol of the sun’s circle and time, Chi denotes the completeness of a structure that is poised to become the foundation for a new cycle.

Upright position: Cosmic equilibrium
In the upright position, Chi means finding harmony between spiritual aspirations and material tasks. It's a symbol of the right crossroads.
Successfully combining conflicting factors into a single plan.
The manifestation of creative power through the hands (skill, healing).
Protecting the "World Soul" and entering the rhythm of eternal time.
Obtaining authority and spiritual responsibility (energy of the shoulders).

Reversed position: Hysterema - HYsterema
The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (HYsterema - "Hysterema", deficiency or lack), when the "crossed ties" of reality disintegrate.
Chaos and disorientation due to the inability to reconcile the two ways.
Destruction of the structure of time, lateness, fatal errors in calculations.
Weakness in the hands or “heaviness on the shoulders” is the inability to act.
Spiritual stagnation caused by loss of connection with the source of vital heat.

Body Practice and Meditation
Meditation: Focus on your shoulder girdle. Visualize two intersecting lines of golden flame passing through your shoulders and arms. Imagine that you are the center where heaven and earth connect. Pronounce the hoarse, ejective "X-h-h" sound as the "World Soul" fills your space.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, legs wide apart. Raise your hands up and to the sides so that your body forms the shape of a capital letter Χ. Open your hands. Loudly and flamboyantly pronounce the KHENNEOFEOCH spell, asserting yourself as the fulcrum of the universe.

Bodywork: Chi controls his shoulders and arms. Exercises on rotation of shoulder joints and "stretching" of hands to the sides are recommended to activate the energy of Pneuma (pneyma - "Pneuma", spirit).

psi.name: Psi
psi.tagline: Metaphysics of the Spiritualized Sphere and Breath Psyche
psi.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Psyche - Psyche and Sphericity In the process of unfolding reality, Psi (Ψ, ψ) acts as a complex, "double" element (diployn - "diplun"), combining the explosive force of Pi and the hissing of Sigma. The Gnostics classified it as "semi-vowel" (Hemiphonon - "hemiphonon"), associating it with the Aeons of Logos (Word) and Zoe (Life), since it occupies an intermediate position between pure spirit and dense matter. The main philosophical symbol of this letter is Psyche (Psyche - "Psyche", soul).

Neoplatonists, such as Theodore Azinsky, saw in the form of a Psi the image of a sphere (sphaira - "sphere"), claiming that its curved lines, when continued, describe the shape of the globe. In the structure of the mystical "body of truth" Psi takes the place of the Neck (Trachelos - "trachelos"), being the link and channel through which Pneuma (pneyma - "Pneuma", spirit or breath) fills the body.

Magical attunement and root - Hriza
Root (seed sound): Ψ (Psi) is a complex "breathing" sound that mimics the state of foaming or "cold" (psychron - "psychron", cold) gust.

Incantation: "PsYChOMPOIAPs" (Psychompoyaps) is a magical name of power from ancient lists, serving as the sound body of the letter Psi and opening access to the energies of mental transformation.

Associative colors: Deep Purple (color of spirit), Transparent Blue (purity of Psyche), Indigo (depth of water).

Deity: PSIHE (Soul) or Holy Ghost (Pneyma HAgion - "Pneuma agion"), whose numerical value in some writings (710) coincides with the meaning of the name of the letter itself.

Center in the body: Neck (Trachelos).

The numerical essence is the energy of seven hundred Psi - 700. Its numerical root (pythmen) is 7, which connects the letter with the sacred Heptad (Hebdomad) and the planetary spheres. In numerology, Psi is considered the number of “Intellectual Life”, representing the ability of the soul to embrace the entire universe with its spherical nature.

Upright position: Spiritual Integration In the upright position, Psi means gaining wholeness and conscious contact with the higher self. It is a symbol of the soul opened to the heavenly light.
Psychological healing and restoration of internal balance.
Success in cases that require intuition and an understanding of ulterior motives.
The harmony between the will (Pi) and its manifestation (Sigma).
Protection of the "Sphere of Spirit" from external chaotic influences.

Reversed position: Hysterema
